name: 3D AMR Grid Stitching
definition: A technique to connect fine grids embedded in coarse grids in 3D AMR data by generating intermediate 'stitch cells' (pyramids, deformed triangle prisms, deformed hexahedra, tetrahedra) to ensure crack-free topology between different refinement levels.
summary: 3D AMR Grid Stitching generates crack-free isosurfaces by constructing intermediate stitch cells to bridge topological gaps between refinement levels without subdividing boundary elements.
